title: Well made nice bottles
text: Well made nice bottles. I make almond milk and these bottles work perfectly.  You will need a bottle brush to clean because it is rather hard to get clean without something inside to clean it.  Heavy and perfect.

product_metadata.title: The Dairy Shoppe 1 Ltr. (33.8 oz.) Glass Milk Bottle Vintage Style with Cap & NEW Silicone Pour Spouts! (2 Pack)
features: Durable 33.8 Oz Glass Milk Bottle is hard to break because of it's thick sides
Re-usable BPA-free 48 MM Snap-on caps (2) are included. Remove the seal and press firmly onto the bottle to snap on securely.
Includes two (2) NEW Silicone Pour Spouts allowing for drip free pouring! See note in description.
description: Tough Glass Bottle is great for water, milk, juices, as well as honey, maple syrup, and jam. Inert glass doesn't leach chemicals the way plastic does even with the most acidic contents. Compact glass bottle measures approx. 9.5 inches tall and 3-1/2" by 3-1/2" to fit large water bottle holders and fridge door shelves. Includes two NEW Silicone Pour Spouts allowing for drip free pouring!
